Thanks for telling me, Nadia. I'll keep it between us. I won't pass the Vantorre Albany plans or the Bluefin name to Ruth or to any channel, and I won't record it anywhere others can read.

If Ruth needs to be briefed, that's a conversation for you or Mateo to have with her. I can help you plan it, for example what to cover and who should be in the room, but I won't bring it to her myself.
